Everton Women vs Aston Villa: WSL Match Preview — The Blues are without a league win in 2026 and have still yet to taste victory at their new home, something they will have a chance to correct

summary: Current previews confirm the fixture (Goodison Park, Sun 25 Oct 2026, 14:00 UTC) and give no late team-news fact that contradicts the frozen snapshot: Everton sit 6th on 9 points from 6 with all three wins at home and all three defeats away, while Villa arrive off a 2-1 win at Liverpool (their first WSL win of the season) under interim boss Sorensen. The Royal Blue Mersey 'preview' in the base packet is actually a stale Feb 2026 piece (Sorensen era, Toni Payne injury), so it was not relied on; no injury/lineup report materially undercuts the AWAY leg, so the +6.1% edge stands as priced.
